# Contributing

Read the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) and the [architecture guide](../docs/guides/ARCHITECTURE.md). For local setup, build, and test commands, see [Testing and delivery](../docs/guides/TESTING.md).

Branch from `main` using a name such as `fix/preview-detection` or `docs/install-guide`. Keep commits focused and use Conventional Commit subjects such as `fix: preserve blank lines in Drive source`. Use signed commits if your Git signing is configured.

Run `npm run check` and describe any manual Chrome/Drive checks in your pull request. For preview changes, use a minimal sample Markdown file and remove private file IDs and account information from screenshots or logs. Use the [security policy](SECURITY.md) for private reports.
